To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the drainage basins over two regional structures in the northeast India have been influenced by tectonic activities and that the present state of tectonism varies from active to slight active phase in the two regional structures.

the morphological features of the drainage basin of streams are influenced by regional tectonic activities and lithology has little influence in the distribution pattern along the longitudinal profiles.

the drainage basin morphotextonic indices have been applied in assessment of tectonics of the Belt of Schuppen and the Daukhi fault, which are two of the most prominent regional structures of Northeast India.

the study of the influence of regional structures on the drainage basin morphotextonics and the assessment of present state of tectonics of these structures in the northeast India.
the application of morphotectonic approach for assessment of the influence and the present tctonic state of two prominent regional structures of northeastern India.
the application of drainage basin morphometric analysis in the assessment of tectonically active regional structures of the Northeast India.

the drainage basin morphotextonic analysis is an efficient and reliable tool in assessment of the tectonic activity and the present status of the regional structures.
